verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says users describe a control and its AI agents collect, validate, and package evidence 'on your schedule', which is a first-party, user-defined recurring background automation. However, this is a single marketing line. Built-in daily code scans are fixed system behavior, and service keys for agent automation are developer building blocks, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: documentation of how automations are configured and scheduled, what triggers or actions are supported, monitoring and run history for background jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
